name: Leader Breakout & Pullback Strategy - All US
description: Buy strongest stocks on breakout or pullback with volume confirmation across all US symbols
entry_rule: close >= 15 & close / close_126 >= 1.5 & close > sma_200 & sma_50 > sma_200 & sma_10 > sma_20 & sma_20 > sma_50 & spy_close > spy_sma_50 & rsi_14 >= 35 & rsi_14 <= 70 & volume >= vol_sma_20 * 1.2 & (atr_20 / close) >= 0.025 & ((close > high_20) | (abs(close - sma_10) / close <= 0.02) | (abs(close - sma_20) / close <= 0.02) | (abs(close - sma_50) / close <= 0.02))
entry_rule_long: close >= 15 & close / close_126 >= 1.5 & close > sma_200 & sma_50 > sma_200 & sma_10 > sma_20 & sma_20 > sma_50 & spy_close > spy_sma_50 & rsi_14 >= 35 & rsi_14 <= 70 & volume >= vol_sma_20 * 1.2 & (atr_20 / close) >= 0.025 & ((close > high_20) | (abs(close - sma_10) / close <= 0.02) | (abs(close - sma_20) / close <= 0.02) | (abs(close - sma_50) / close <= 0.02))
